howto.name: Upload an MP3
howto.text: Drop an .mp3 file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools rewraps via FFmpeg
howto.text: The decoded audio is stored losslessly. Nothing further is lost, and nothing is restored: the output sounds identical to the MP3 and is larger.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. FLAC wraps the decoded audio losslessly, so nothing further is lost — but nothing is restored either. The output is larger than the MP3 and sounds identical to it. Use this when a workflow demands FLAC input, not to improve quality.

faq.q: Does MP3 to FLAC restore lossless quality?
faq.a: No. FLAC will losslessly preserve whatever is in the MP3, but it cannot recreate the detail MP3 already discarded — you get a larger file, not better audio. Convert only when a tool specifically requires a lossless container.

faq.q: When is MP3 to FLAC actually useful?
faq.a: When a workflow or device only accepts FLAC/lossless input, or to archive the file without further generational loss.
No. Uploads and outputs are temporary and deleted after the download.
